method: Existing short lessons and manifest were checked first. References below were read as available online editions; exact claims are limited to the cited scope. Modern teaching sequences are labelled as AstroVedansh's instructional method, not as invented verses.

sources.title: Phaladeepika, Chapter 4 — Shadbala
sources.scope: Verse 4 discusses retrogression and brightness as strength factors; it does not say every retrograde planet gives uniformly good events.

sources.title: Phaladeepika, Chapter 15 — Method of studying Bhavas
sources.scope: House, house lord, occupation/aspect and karaka are considered together; used for the evidence-weighing method.

sources.title: Phaladeepika, Chapter 20 — Dasas of Bhava Lords
sources.scope: Used only for the principle that a house lord's period can foreground its house topics.

sources.title: Phaladeepika, Chapter 10 — Seventh house
sources.scope: Used for the traditional connection of the seventh house, its lord, Venus, navamsha and timing; not as a guarantee of marriage.

sources.title: Phaladeepika, Chapter 6 — Yogas
sources.scope: Used to show that named yogas have exact formation conditions and cannot be declared from a loose resemblance.
